name: AttachToRunningExcelNode
label: Attach to Running Excel Workbook
description: Attaches to a running Excel instance and opens the specified workbook if not already open.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: ExcelApplication
fields.label: Excel Application
fields.description: The running Excel Application object to attach to.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path of the Excel file to open or attach to in the running Excel instance.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: Returns the attached or opened workbook.
